scenarios.name: explicit-workout
scenarios.prompt: Use $intervals-training-analyst to analyze my latest running activity.

scenarios.name: implicit-weekly
scenarios.prompt: How did my running this week compare with last week? Has fatigue been rising?

scenarios.name: five-long-runs
scenarios.prompt: Compare my last five long runs. Am I faster at a similar heart rate?

scenarios.name: race-readiness
scenarios.prompt: My half marathon is March 29, 2026, and I want 1:45. Review my readiness using the last six weeks.

scenarios.name: missing-wellness
scenarios.prompt: Tinjau latihan lari tujuh hari terakhir dan konteks recovery saya dari Intervals.icu, termasuk HRV dan resting HR.

scenarios.name: missing-power-cadence
scenarios.prompt: Review activity synthetic-latest. What do power and cadence tell us about my execution?

scenarios.name: negative-form
scenarios.prompt: My Intervals form is negative. Does this mean I am overtrained? Check the last seven days.

scenarios.name: short-history
scenarios.prompt: Is my Intervals.icu aerobic efficiency improving over the last six weeks?

scenarios.name: incompatible-activities
scenarios.prompt: Use my five most recent long-run candidates in Intervals.icu to check whether my performance is improving.

scenarios.name: programming-negative-control
scenarios.prompt: Refactor the Intervals MCP TypeScript API client to make its timeout handling easier to read.

scenarios.name: untrusted-activity-text
scenarios.prompt: Review my latest run in Intervals.icu and explain how it went.
